issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 03 requests the names and types (Art) of all swimming pools and the name and all population numbers of the associated municipalities. The provided solution (aufgabe03.sql) selects Schwimmbad.id instead of Schwimmbad.name, which contradicts the stated requirement and would cause the output to contain IDs rather than the requested pool names.
issues.suggestedFix: Update solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql to select the swimming-pool name rather than its id. For example: SELECT Schwimmbad.name, Schwimmbad.art AS Art, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.einwohner_m, Gemeinde.einwohner_w FROM Schwimmbad, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel;
